reports.headline: Resident Seen Walking to the Cliffs at Night
reports.body: The resident from the cottage was seen walking alone to the cliffs {dir} of the village {dist} after dark. {name} followed and swears a tall shape walked beside them the whole way, between them and the edge. Whatever it is, it did not let them fall.

reports.headline: Something Keeps the Cliff Edge
reports.body: Travelers on the cliff path {dir} of here {dist} after dark have been pushed back from the edge by hands they could not see. {name} says it was not cruel. It was frightened for them.
